summary: Phase 2 features validated end-to-end. Backend pytest 7/7 passing (birthday PUT + upcoming-birthdays ordering + business_type on org + service photos: upload 2 / reject 3rd / delete + regression logins). UI E2E validated: (1) BookingTools renders 2 grouped blocks with 4 testids in both Manager dashboard and Staff profile; Copy link writes URL to clipboard and QR modal renders canvas. (2) StaffProfile shows Herramientas para Clientes with no admin controls added. (3) Client birthday input (client-birthday-input-desktop) inside 'Ver Historial' Sheet saves via PUT and shows 'Cumpleaños actualizado' toast. (4) MarketingCampaigns audience toggle all/birthdays works, switching to birthdays shows day-remaining badges, birthday template selectable with 🎂 preview. (5) BusinessProfile business-type-select present with value 'barbershop'. (6) ManagerServices Editar dialog shows 'Imágenes del servicio (máx. 2)' section: upload 1 -> delete-0 appears; upload 2 -> delete-1 appears and upload input disappears; deleting frees a slot and toast 'Imagen eliminada' shows. (7) Sidebar categories operación/finanzas/abastecimiento/crecimiento/administración/ayuda all have sidebar-section-<label> toggle buttons with aria-expanded; collapsing 'Crecimiento' persists to localStorage nexus-sidebar-collapsed and survives page reload (aria-expanded=false after reload). Owner/Manager/Staff regressions pass.

issues: OnboardingTour dialog (role=dialog, aria-labelledby=nexus-onboarding-title) intercepts pointer events on the whole page (including sidebar/dashboard) on first login. Users must close the X before any interaction. Consider auto-dismissing on outside click or lowering the modal z-index/overlay for the sidebar. This blocks first-run testing but does not break real usage.

critical_code_review_comments: service_media.py correctly reuses product_catalog + professional_media pipelines and enforces MAX_SERVICE_PHOTOS=2 on the backend; verified 3rd upload returns 400 via pytest, and the frontend hides the 'Agregar' input once len(photos)>=2 (defense-in-depth OK).

server.py update_client accepts birthday via query param with regex validation r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}'; empty string clears the field (verified). GET /api/clients/upcoming-birthdays orders ascending by days_until and handles year rollover (verified via pytest with target=today+3).

AdminShell.jsx collapsedSections keyed by section.label — labels are the display strings ('Crecimiento', etc.). localStorage key 'nexus-sidebar-collapsed' persists correctly across reloads (verified).

OnboardingTour continues to intercept sidebar clicks on first login (dialog with z-100 overlay). Fase 1 iteration_22 flagged this and it is unchanged. autoStart gate for owner/manager-with-org still opens the tour on first login; consider suppressing when user already dismissed on any prior session or persisting the 'seen' flag server-side.
MarketingCampaigns preview correctly personalizes with business name and business_type-sensitive templates from whatsappService (VERTICAL_LABELS).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 flows: bookingtools-manager, bookingtools-staff, sidebar-collapse-persist, business-type, marketing-audience+birthday-template, client-birthday, service-photos)
